g.textArea: One check per table: does the spilled row list have exactly as many rows as the table built beside it?

rect.data-description: FORMULA (this sheet). Reads the spill address out of column C's own formula: =SUBSTITUTE(MID(FORMULATEXT(C5),FIND("!",FORMULATEXT(C5))+1,99),")","")
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). =ROWS(ANCHORARRAY(Sunday!A3)), and the same for each sheet's row list.
FORMULA (this sheet). F =C5-E5. G =IF(C5=E5,"Match",IF(E5>C5,"Table longer","Array longer")).
NOTE. It only counts rows. It would not catch the BOM double count, K4 not matching today, the stale Sunday!B1 date, the dead order grids or #N/A values inside matching tables.
FORMULA (this sheet). Sunday!A3# has 395 rows, table Sunday has 395; difference 0. Match: every SKU has a row.
FORMULA (this sheet). Monday!A3# has 395 rows, table Monday has 395; difference 0. Match: every SKU has a row.
FORMULA (this sheet). Tuesday!A3# has 395 rows, table Tuesday has 398; difference -3. Table longer: extra table rows below the spill show #N/A; harmless.
FORMULA (this sheet). Wednesday!A3# has 395 rows, table Wednesday has 447; difference -52. Table longer: extra table rows below the spill show #N/A; harmless.
FORMULA (this sheet). Thursday!A3# has 395 rows, table Thursday has 447; difference -52. Table longer: extra table rows below the spill show #N/A; harmless.
FORMULA (this sheet). Friday!A3# has 395 rows, table Friday has 447; difference -52. Table longer: extra table rows below the spill show #N/A; harmless.
FORMULA (this sheet). Daily Supply & Demand!A8# has 275 rows, table DSD_DSnD has 275; difference 0. Match: every SKU has a row.
FORMULA (this sheet). Daily Supply & Demand!A287# has 120 rows, table Dist_DSnD has 120; difference 0. Match: every SKU has a row.
FORMULA (this sheet). Mix-Slice-Oven!A6# has 390 rows, table Mix_Slice_Oven has 391; difference -1. Table longer: extra table rows below the spill show #N/A; harmless.
FORMULA (this sheet). Mix-Slice-Oven!A410# has 68 rows, table Oven_Info has 86; difference -18. Table longer: extra table rows below the spill show #N/A; harmless.
ISSUE. DoughWeights!A4# has 453 rows, table DoughWeight has 452; difference 1. Array longer: SKUs at the end of the spill have no table row and are silently dropped.
